name: Hawaiian Veggie Burger with Citrus Grilled Pineapple, Zucchini & Onion
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and cut crosswise into 1-inch thick rounds. Peel, halve, and cut onion lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges. Place both in a medium bowl.

Cut off skin from pineapple; halve and remove the core. Cut a portion of the pineapple into 8 thin slices for the burgers; set aside. Large dice remaining pineapple and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Zest lime into the bowl. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine. (Reserve lime for later use.)
Thread veggies and pineapple onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the veggies and pineapple directly on the grill pan. (Reserve the bowl for later use.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the veggies are charred and tender, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the ginger and garlic; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 4 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.
When the skewers are done, coat the pan with oil. Add burger patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, cut reserved lime into wedges.
Toast buns on the pan (if desired).
Spread mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with a burger and two slices of pineapple. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and skewers between plates. Squeeze lime over the skewers and enjoy!
author: Mealime
